title: Effect of Benson Relaxation Exercise on Anxiety Level and Sleep Quality in Adolescents Receiving Inpatient Treatment in a Psychiatric Clinic.
summary:
PURPOSE: To evaluate the effects of Benson relaxation exercise (BRE) on anxiety levels and sleep quality among adolescents receiving inpatient treatment in a psychiatric clinic.
METHOD: The current study used a randomized controlled experimental design. The intervention group (n = 30) performed BRE five times. The control group (n = 30) did not receive any intervention. Both groups completed a pretest, post-test (Day 6), and follow-up test (Day 10).
RESULTS: The intervention group's state anxiety level was found to be significantly lower than that of the control group in the posttest and follow-up test. Sleep quality of the intervention group was also significantly better than that of the control group in the posttest and follow-up test.
CONCLUSION: BRE is effective in reducing anxiety levels and improving sleep quality in adolescents in psychiatric clinics.

标题：本森放松练习对精神科住院青少年焦虑水平及睡眠质量的影响
摘要：目的：评估本森放松练习（BRE）对精神科住院青少年焦虑水平和睡眠质量的影响。方法：本研究采用随机对照实验设计。干预组（n=30）进行五次本森放松练习，对照组（n=30）未接受任何干预。两组均完成前测、后测（第6天）和随访测试（第10天）。结果：干预组在后测和随访测试中的状态焦虑水平显著低于对照组。干预组的睡眠质量在后测和随访测试中也显著优于对照组。结论：本森放松练习能有效降低精神科青少年患者的焦虑水平并改善其睡眠质量。
关键词：本森放松练习；焦虑；睡眠质量；青少年；精神科

title: HMGA2 regulates fear and growth: Canine GWAS and functional evidence.
summary: Fear is an evolutionarily conserved survival mechanism. Fear behavior is strongly correlated with body size in dogs, the genetic basis of fear regulation independent of size-related traits remains unclear. Through cross-breed genome-wide association analysis, we identified association between HMGA2 gene and fear traits. Our functional validation revealed that viral overexpression of Hmga2 in the mouse basolateral amygdala attenuated fear memory formation independent of body weight, while Hmga2 knockout (KO) mice exhibited enhanced fear memory. Transcriptomic analyses linked Hmga2 to modulation of neurotransmitter activity, synaptic plasticity (including GABAergic signaling), and neurogenesis, with additional roles in early brain development revealed by embryonic KO studies. We also identified a mutation in an enhancer that can regulate HMGA2 expression in human HEK293T cell line. Our findings establish HMGA2 as a pleiotropic regulator of fear behavior decoupled from its effects on body size, resolving a long-standing confound in canine behavioral genetics.

标题：HMGA2调节恐惧与体型：犬类GWAS及功能证据
摘要：恐惧是一种进化上保守的生存机制。在犬类中，恐惧行为与体型大小高度相关，但独立于体型相关性状的恐惧调节遗传基础仍不清楚。通过跨品种全基因组关联分析，我们发现HMGA2基因与恐惧性状相关。功能验证表明，在小鼠基底外侧杏仁核中病毒过表达Hmga2可减弱恐惧记忆形成（独立于体重），而Hmga2敲除小鼠则表现出增强的恐惧记忆。转录组分析将Hmga2与神经递质活性调节、突触可塑性（包括GABA能信号）及神经发生联系起来，胚胎敲除研究还揭示其在早期大脑发育中的额外作用。此外，我们在人类HEK293T细胞系中发现了一个可调节HMGA2表达的增强子突变。我们的研究确立了HMGA2作为恐惧行为的多效性调节因子，其效应与体型影响脱钩，从而解决了犬类行为遗传学中长期存在的混淆问题。
关键词：恐惧行为；HMGA2；全基因组关联分析；情绪调节；犬类遗传学

title: Neuroinflammation in the medial prefrontal cortex is associated with early-life stress susceptibility in male rats.
summary: Early-life stress increases individuals' susceptibility to developing anxiety and depression disorders in adulthood, but a substantial proportion of individuals are resilient to these disorders. The medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) serves as a key neural substrate underlying stress susceptibility and resilience. Nevertheless, the precise neurobiological mechanisms governing these differential stress responses remain incompletely understood. To elucidate the role of mPFC in the neural mechanisms underlying stress susceptibility and resilience, adult rats exposed to early-life stress were stratified into stress-susceptible and stress-resilient groups based on anxiety- and depression-like behavioral phenotypes. Transcriptomic sequencing of the mPFC was performed to identify differentially regulated pathways and genes. The TNF-associated pathway was significantly upregulated in the susceptible group. Next, integrated omics analysis implicated inflammatory signaling as a pivotal mechanistic contributor, which was further validated using molecular biological assays. Further immunofluorescence staining revealed that the density of astrocytes decreased and activated microglia with decreased intersections increased in the mPFC of susceptible rats. Overall, these findings suggest that neuroinflammation in the mPFC plays a significant role in behavioral and neurobiological changes in susceptible male rats.

标题：内侧前额叶皮质中的神经炎症与雄性大鼠早期应激易感性相关  
摘要：早期应激增加了个体在成年期发展为焦虑和抑郁障碍的易感性，但相当比例的个体对这些障碍具有韧性。内侧前额叶皮质（mPFC）作为对应激易感性和韧性的关键神经基质，然而，调节这些差异性应激反应的精确神经生物学机制尚未完全阐明。为阐明mPFC在应激易感性和韧性神经机制中的作用，将暴露于早期应激的成年大鼠基于焦虑样和抑郁样行为表型分为应激易感组和应激韧性组。对mPFC进行转录组测序以识别差异调节的通路和基因。在易感组中，TNF相关通路显著上调。接下来，整合组学分析表明炎症信号是关键的机制贡献因素，并通过分子生物学实验进一步验证。免疫荧光染色进一步揭示，易感大鼠mPFC中星形胶质细胞密度降低，活化的小胶质细胞（其交叉点减少）增加。总体而言，这些发现表明mPFC中的神经炎症在易感雄性大鼠的行为和神经生物学变化中发挥重要作用。  
关键词：早期应激；应激易感性；内侧前额叶皮质；神经炎症；情绪障碍
